adx.title: ADX (14) on the S&P 500 ETF
adx.caption: ADX plots trend strength from 0 to 100 with no direction. Readings above the 25 line are commonly read as trending and readings below it as a range. It is smoothed twice, so it lags.
adx.alt: ADX (14) on the S&P 500 ETF. ADX plots trend strength from 0 to 100 with no direction. Readings above the 25 line are commonly read as trending and readings below it as a range. It is smoothed twice, so it lags.
adx.credit: S&P 500 ETF (SPY), daily, Feb 2024 to Nov 2024. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

alma.title: ALMA (9, offset 0.85, sigma 6) on the S&P 500 ETF
alma.caption: ALMA weights the last nine closes with a bell curve peaked near the newest bar. It follows price closely while staying smooth.
alma.alt: ALMA (9, offset 0.85, sigma 6) on the S&P 500 ETF. ALMA weights the last nine closes with a bell curve peaked near the newest bar. It follows price closely while staying smooth.
alma.credit: S&P 500 ETF (SPY), daily, Feb 2024 to Nov 2024. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

aroon.title: Aroon (25) on gold
aroon.caption: Aroon Up and Aroon Down show how recently the highest high and lowest low of the last 25 bars occurred, from 0 to 100. The dashed lines mark the 70 and 30 conventions, and crossings of the two lines can whip back and forth in ranges.
aroon.alt: Aroon (25) on gold. Aroon Up and Aroon Down show how recently the highest high and lowest low of the last 25 bars occurred, from 0 to 100. The dashed lines mark the 70 and 30 conventions, and crossings of the two lines can whip back and forth in ranges.
aroon.credit: Gold futures, daily, Jan 2024 to Oct 2024. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

aroon-oscillator.title: Aroon Oscillator (25) on Bitcoin
aroon-oscillator.caption: Aroon Up minus Aroon Down, from -100 to +100. Above zero the latest high is more recent than the latest low, below zero the reverse. It lags, because it reports extremes after they form.
aroon-oscillator.alt: Aroon Oscillator (25) on Bitcoin. Aroon Up minus Aroon Down, from -100 to +100. Above zero the latest high is more recent than the latest low, below zero the reverse. It lags, because it reports extremes after they form.
aroon-oscillator.credit: Bitcoin (BTC/USD), daily, Mar 2024 to Dec 2024. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

atr.title: Average True Range (14) on the S&P 500 ETF
atr.caption: ATR jumps when daily ranges widen in the April sell-off, then falls back as the market calms.

bollinger-bands.title: Bollinger Bands (20, 2) on EUR/USD
bollinger-bands.caption: Price walks the upper band during a strong trend; touches alone are not reversal signals.
bollinger-bands.alt: Bollinger Bands (20, 2) on EUR/USD. Price walks the upper band during a strong trend; touches alone are not reversal signals.
bollinger-bands.credit: EUR/USD, daily, Jan 2025 to Aug 2025. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

choppiness-index.title: Choppiness Index (14) on Apple
choppiness-index.caption: The index runs from 0 to 100. Readings above 61.8 describe a choppy, sideways market and readings below 38.2 an efficient, trending one. It gives no direction.
choppiness-index.alt: Choppiness Index (14) on Apple. The index runs from 0 to 100. Readings above 61.8 describe a choppy, sideways market and readings below 38.2 an efficient, trending one. It gives no direction.

death-cross.title: Death cross: 50-day under 200-day SMA on the S&P 500 ETF
death-cross.caption: The 50-day SMA moving from above to below the 200-day SMA, on closing values, is called a death cross. It is a lagging signal.
death-cross.alt: Death cross: 50-day under 200-day SMA on the S&P 500 ETF. The 50-day SMA moving from above to below the 200-day SMA, on closing values, is called a death cross. It is a lagging signal.

dema.title: 20-day Double EMA on the S&P 500 ETF
dema.caption: DEMA (20) built as 2 x EMA minus the EMA of the EMA. It hugs price more closely than a plain EMA, at the cost of extra noise.
dema.alt: 20-day Double EMA on the S&P 500 ETF. DEMA (20) built as 2 x EMA minus the EMA of the EMA. It hugs price more closely than a plain EMA, at the cost of extra noise.
dema.credit: S&P 500 ETF (SPY), daily, Jan 2024 to Oct 2024. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

dmi.title: DMI (14): +DI and -DI on EUR/USD
dmi.caption: +DI measures upward pressure and -DI downward pressure over 14 bars. A cross of the two lines is Wilder's basic signal, and crosses are frequent when the market is sideways. The ADX line is shown with them.
dmi.alt: DMI (14): +DI and -DI on EUR/USD. +DI measures upward pressure and -DI downward pressure over 14 bars. A cross of the two lines is Wilder's basic signal, and crosses are frequent when the market is sideways. The ADX line is shown with them.
dmi.credit: EUR/USD, daily, Mar 2024 to Dec 2024. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

donchian-channels.title: 20-day Donchian Channel on gold
donchian-channels.caption: Closes beyond the prior 20-day high mark breakouts in a strong trend.
donchian-channels.alt: 20-day Donchian Channel on gold. Closes beyond the prior 20-day high mark breakouts in a strong trend.
donchian-channels.credit: Gold futures, daily, Jan 2025 to Oct 2025. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

exponential-moving-average.title: 20-day exponential moving average on Bitcoin
exponential-moving-average.caption: The 20-day EMA follows price closely; crosses come quickly but whipsaw in sideways spells.
exponential-moving-average.alt: 20-day exponential moving average on Bitcoin. The 20-day EMA follows price closely; crosses come quickly but whipsaw in sideways spells.

golden-cross.title: Golden cross: 50-day over 200-day SMA on the S&P 500 ETF
golden-cross.caption: The 50-day SMA moving from below to above the 200-day SMA, on closing values, is called a golden cross. It shows up well after price has turned.
golden-cross.alt: Golden cross: 50-day over 200-day SMA on the S&P 500 ETF. The 50-day SMA moving from below to above the 200-day SMA, on closing values, is called a golden cross. It shows up well after price has turned.

heikin-ashi.title: Heikin-Ashi on Bitcoin
heikin-ashi.caption: The lines show the four Heikin-Ashi values (open, high, low, close) over normal candles. Each is averaged with the previous bar, so runs of one colour mark smoother trends. The values are averages, not tradable prices.
heikin-ashi.alt: Heikin-Ashi on Bitcoin. The lines show the four Heikin-Ashi values (open, high, low, close) over normal candles. Each is averaged with the previous bar, so runs of one colour mark smoother trends. The values are averages, not tradable prices.

hull-moving-average.title: 21-day Hull Moving Average on gold
hull-moving-average.caption: HMA (21) uses weighted averages to stay smooth while reacting quickly. It can overshoot at turns.
hull-moving-average.alt: 21-day Hull Moving Average on gold. HMA (21) uses weighted averages to stay smooth while reacting quickly. It can overshoot at turns.

ichimoku-cloud.title: Ichimoku Cloud (9, 26, 52) on gold
ichimoku-cloud.caption: Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen are 9 and 26 bar high-low midpoints. Senkou Span A and B, which form the cloud, are plotted 26 bars ahead, and the Chikou Span is the close drawn 26 bars back. The cloud under a candle was calculated 26 bars earlier.
ichimoku-cloud.alt: Ichimoku Cloud (9, 26, 52) on gold. Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen are 9 and 26 bar high-low midpoints. Senkou Span A and B, which form the cloud, are plotted 26 bars ahead, and the Chikou Span is the close drawn 26 bars back. The cloud under a candle was calculated 26 bars earlier.

kama.title: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (10, 2, 30) on the S&P 500 ETF
kama.caption: KAMA speeds up when price moves in one direction and flattens in noisy sideways stretches, using an efficiency ratio over 10 bars.
kama.alt: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (10, 2, 30) on the S&P 500 ETF. KAMA speeds up when price moves in one direction and flattens in noisy sideways stretches, using an efficiency ratio over 10 bars.

keltner-channels.title: Keltner Channels (20 EMA, 2 x ATR 10) on Apple
keltner-channels.caption: An EMA centre line with ATR-based bands that widen when volatility rises.
keltner-channels.alt: Keltner Channels (20 EMA, 2 x ATR 10) on Apple. An EMA centre line with ATR-based bands that widen when volatility rises.

know-sure-thing.title: Know Sure Thing (daily set) on Apple
know-sure-thing.caption: The KST adds four smoothed rates of change (10, 15, 20 and 30 bars), weighted 1 to 4, with a 9-bar signal line. It swings around zero and tracks larger cycles, so it lags and crosses often in flat markets.
know-sure-thing.alt: Know Sure Thing (daily set) on Apple. The KST adds four smoothed rates of change (10, 15, 20 and 30 bars), weighted 1 to 4, with a 9-bar signal line. It swings around zero and tracks larger cycles, so it lags and crosses often in flat markets.

linear-regression.title: Linear Regression curve (14) on EUR/USD
linear-regression.caption: At each bar the curve plots the end point of the least squares line through the last 14 closes. It follows price with less lag than a simple average but overshoots at turning points.
linear-regression.alt: Linear Regression curve (14) on EUR/USD. At each bar the curve plots the end point of the least squares line through the last 14 closes. It follows price with less lag than a simple average but overshoots at turning points.

linear-regression-channel.title: Linear Regression Channel (100, 2 SD) on the S&P 500 ETF
linear-regression-channel.caption: The centre line is the regression end point of the last 100 closes, with bands 2 standard deviations of the closes around the line. This moving version is recalculated each bar, so it differs from a channel drawn once across a fixed window.
linear-regression-channel.alt: Linear Regression Channel (100, 2 SD) on the S&P 500 ETF. The centre line is the regression end point of the last 100 closes, with bands 2 standard deviations of the closes around the line. This moving version is recalculated each bar, so it differs from a channel drawn once across a fixed window.

linear-regression-slope.title: Linear Regression Slope (14) on gold
linear-regression-slope.caption: The slope of the best-fit line through the last 14 closes, in price units per bar. Above zero the fitted line is rising and below zero it is falling. It depends on the price level, so compare readings on the same instrument.
linear-regression-slope.alt: Linear Regression Slope (14) on gold. The slope of the best-fit line through the last 14 closes, in price units per bar. Above zero the fitted line is rising and below zero it is falling. It depends on the price level, so compare readings on the same instrument.

lsma.title: 25-day Least Squares Moving Average on gold
lsma.caption: LSMA (25) plots the end point of a straight line fitted to the last 25 closes, so it leans with the recent slope.
lsma.alt: 25-day Least Squares Moving Average on gold. LSMA (25) plots the end point of a straight line fitted to the last 25 closes, so it leans with the recent slope.

macd.title: MACD (12, 26, 9) on gold

mass-index.title: Mass Index (9, 25) on Bitcoin
mass-index.caption: The Mass Index sums the ratio of a 9-bar EMA of the high-low range to its own EMA over 25 bars. A reversal bulge is a rise above 27 followed by a fall below 26.5. It shows range behaviour and gives no direction.
mass-index.alt: Mass Index (9, 25) on Bitcoin. The Mass Index sums the ratio of a 9-bar EMA of the high-low range to its own EMA over 25 bars. A reversal bulge is a rise above 27 followed by a fall below 26.5. It shows range behaviour and gives no direction.

mcginley-dynamic.title: McGinley Dynamic (14) on gold
mcginley-dynamic.caption: The McGinley Dynamic adjusts its own speed: it moves faster when price pulls away from it and slower when price returns.
mcginley-dynamic.alt: McGinley Dynamic (14) on gold. The McGinley Dynamic adjusts its own speed: it moves faster when price pulls away from it and slower when price returns.
mcginley-dynamic.credit: Gold futures, daily, Feb 2024 to Nov 2024. Calculated with Technical Analysis Bible's own indicator code.

moving-average-crossover.title: 20/50-day SMA crossover on gold
moving-average-crossover.caption: A fast SMA (20) crossing a slow SMA (50). Crosses up are bullish and crosses down bearish, with extra false signals in sideways spells.
moving-average-crossover.alt: 20/50-day SMA crossover on gold. A fast SMA (20) crossing a slow SMA (50). Crosses up are bullish and crosses down bearish, with extra false signals in sideways spells.

moving-average-envelope.title: 20-day SMA envelope (2.5 percent) on EUR/USD
moving-average-envelope.caption: A 20-day SMA with lines a fixed 2.5 percent above and below. The band width is a constant share of the average, not of volatility.

moving-average-ribbon.title: Ten-EMA ribbon (10 to 100) on Apple

parabolic-sar.title: Parabolic SAR (0.02, 0.02, 0.2) on Apple
parabolic-sar.caption: Parabolic SAR trails price and accelerates toward it as a trend runs, then flips when price trades through it. It is drawn here as a line rather than the usual dots. Flips are frequent in sideways markets.

rsi.title: RSI (14) on the S&P 500 ETF

supertrend.title: Supertrend (10, 3) on gold
supertrend.caption: Supertrend sits 3 times the 10-bar ATR from the bar midpoint and only moves in the trend's favour. A close beyond the line flips it to the other side. It adapts to volatility but still lags.

t3-moving-average.title: T3 (5, volume factor 0.7) on Bitcoin
t3-moving-average.caption: T3 runs a lag-cancelling EMA step three times. The line is very smooth, and the 0.7 volume factor can let it overshoot at turns.

tema.title: 20-day Triple EMA on Apple

trix.title: TRIX (15, 9) on gold

vortex-indicator.caption: VI+ and VI- measure upward and downward movement over 14 bars relative to true range. A cross of the two lines is the basic signal, and both hover near 1 when direction is unclear. The dashed line marks 1.
vortex-indicator.alt: Vortex Indicator (14) on the S&P 500 ETF. VI+ and VI- measure upward and downward movement over 14 bars relative to true range. A cross of the two lines is the basic signal, and both hover near 1 when direction is unclear. The dashed line marks 1.

zlema.title: 20-day Zero-Lag EMA on Apple
